# Infospector (vendored)

This folder is a verbatim copy of [Infospector](https://github.com/qmanning/infospector)'s runtime files — `host.css` (the glass toolbar/menu chrome CV Maker wears), `lib.js` and `colorpicker.js` (its color-parsing and glass color-picker helpers) — plus its `LICENSE`. Infospector is MIT-licensed, by the same author as CV Maker. Do not edit these files here; if they need to change, change them upstream and re-copy.
